chunks: Muhammad ibn Ali Majiluwayh narrated to me from Ali ibn Ibrahim from Muhammad ibn Abi Umayr from Ishaq ibn Hilal from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Commander of the Faithful (peace be upon him) said: 'Shall I not inform you about the greatest form of fornication?' He said: 'It is a woman who is lain with on her husband's bed, then brings forth a child from another man, and claims him as her husband's. That is the one whom Allah will not speak to, nor look at on the Day of Resurrection, nor purify, and for them is a painful punishment.'
ai.seo_question: What is considered the greatest form of adultery in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Shaykh al-Saduq records this narration from Imam Ali (AS) to highlight 'zina al-ghishsh' (adultery of deception), where a wife conceals her infidelity by passing off an illegitimate child as her husband's legitimate heir. This specific form is deemed 'greatest' due to the dual violation of sexual purity and the usurpation of lineage rights, leading to severe divine rejection on the Day of Judgment.
